about_the_game:
Bodycam Recorded

Bodycam Recorded is an action-packed first-person shooter that puts you right in the action through a hyper-realistic bodycam perspective, powered by the incredible Unreal Engine 5. Experience intense, immersive combat with unique gun physics and gameplay mechanics designed to deliver a fun yet challenging experience.

Bodycam Recorded features multiple levels, weapon customization, co-op zombies, team deathmatch, free-for-all, and more. All modes and maps can be played solo offline or online with friends, offering endless replay ability and intense firefights every time you play. Outdoor levels include dynamic weather and time-of-day changes, making each game feel fresh, whether it’s raining, snowing, sunny, or overcast.

Bodycam Recorded also features a wide selection of guns with extensive weapon and loadout customization, allowing you to tailor your playstyle to any situation. Look forward to future updates that will introduce new game modes, characters, character customization, weapons, knives, maps, and much more. No hit markers, No kill cams just straight realism.

Developed by KC6067, a passionate solo developer with years of experience and a love for creating unique, high-quality gaming experiences. 

Developer’s Note

I’ve been developing games for years and have a real passion for the bodycam-style genre. This is my second attempt at creating one—my first project, Footage Bodycam, was released last year on Steam but unfortunately suffered from corrupted game files.

For this new project, I initially drew inspiration from Unrecord, and later, when Bodycam was announced, I noticed it used similar assets and the same engine. Some of the environments in my game may look familiar because they come from the FAB Marketplace, not because they were copied. I’m a solo developer and can’t create every map entirely from scratch, so I rely on licensed marketplace assets to build my world.

Despite these challenges, I’m fully committed to crafting a unique, immersive, and realistic bodycam experience that stands out on its own. While the visuals might remind players of other titles in the genre, the gameplay is completely different. My game features unique gun physics, custom movement mechanics, diverse loadouts, and more, creating a fresh and immersive experience

But a massive thanks to games like BODYCAM and UNRECORD for the idea of a bodycam game, Go check there games out!

Music Phonk Cyberpunk by Infraction & Lazerpunk

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X, Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A MINIMUM OF 8GB VRAM IS HIGHLY RECOMENDED
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X, Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (16 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 TI (12 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 12GB VRAM IS RECOMENDED

short_description: Bodycam Recorded is a multiplayer, hyper-realistic FPS. You play the game through the lens of a bodycam, experiencing intense, action-packed maps and game modes like FFA, TDM, and co-op zombies. Play online with your friends or solo offline against AI opponents.
